name: Longer Laser B1 40W
tagline: 40W Longer's large-format diode: bigger bed than Ray5 for sign-sized projects
tldr: Longer Laser B1 40W is the 40W SKU on the Longer longer laser b1 line. Longer's large-format B1 20W diode: this profile is the 20W SKU only; Longer also sells 30W and 40W B1 machines separately. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line: engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

priceRange.note: 40W optical module: verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Cuts 3 mm basswood squares in ~6–10 min in our benchmarks, the fastest B1
Fills at ~80–180 mm/s for quick batches on the large bed
Bundles include a Clean Air Pack ($1,209.99) for indoor use
cons: Wider 0.1 × 0.15 mm spot: small text and portraits are softer
More smoke on long cutting runs: plan ducted exhaust or the Clean Air Pack
Basic set at $699.99, and $1,099.99 for the Pro Max set
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 40W SKU on Longer Laser B1. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.

editorialDepth.advantages: Longer Laser B1 40W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks: fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame: safety and smoke are on you.

faq.question: What does the B1 40W cut?
faq.answer: Longer's spec sheet claims 25 mm basswood in one pass and 50 mm acrylic maximum. In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 6–10 min at 5–14 mm/s, and basswood up to about 10 mm is realistic in passes with air assist. Clear acrylic remains out of reach.

faq.question: Does the 40W lose engraving detail?
faq.answer: A little. Longer lists a 0.1 × 0.15 mm spot for the 40W against 0.08 × 0.1 mm for the 20W and 30W, so small text and portraits look slightly softer. Fills are much faster though, about 80–180 mm/s in our tests.

faq.question: B1 40W or B1 30W?
faq.answer: On Longer's store in October 2026 the basic sets were $699.99 (40W) and $569.99 (30W), a $130 gap. Take the 40W if you cut 6 mm stock or thicker every week; take the 30W if engraving detail matters as much as cutting.

standoutFeatures.title: Strongest B1 cutting
standoutFeatures.body: Longer rates it for 25 mm basswood in one pass; our benchmark shows 3 mm squares in about 6–10 min.

standoutFeatures.title: Fast large-format fills
standoutFeatures.body: About 80–180 mm/s in our tests, useful on the 450 × 440 mm bed.

standoutFeatures.title: Clean Air Pack option
standoutFeatures.body: Longer sells a 40W bundle with an air purifier ($1,209.99 in October 2026) for rooms without exhaust.
